work_order.kill_rule: Kill the write-replacement route if null flips or side effects persist across two materially different local intervention variants.
work_order.promotion_rule: Promote only if lookup mediation remains strong and answer-absent null flips disappear or fall below a predeclared trivial threshold across locality, side-row, and holdout panels.
